chunks: O sons of Adam, We have revealed to you a dress that would both hide your nakedness and be an adornment, but the raiment of piety is best. This is one of the tokens of God: You may haply reflect.

key_terms.سَوْآتِکُمْ: your nakedness, parts of the body to be covered

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the 'garment of piety' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes a hierarchy between material provision and spiritual virtue, where 'libas al-taqwa' (garment of piety) is understood as the inner state of consciousness that protects the soul from divine displeasure. The phrase 'that is from the signs of Allah' (dhalika min ayati Allah) is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as indicating that piety itself is a distinct divine sign or attribute, encouraging believers to reflect on how inner virtue surpasses outer adornment. This concept underscores the Shia emphasis on the integration of outward modesty with inward sincerity as the true measure of human worth.
